name: Is it better to hire a professional painter or paint interior rooms myself?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hire a professional painter or paint interior rooms myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring an experienced contractor ensures proper surface preparation, crisp lines, and an even finish without taking up your personal weekends. While DIY painting saves initial labor expenses, it requires purchasing specialty ladders, drop cloths, sprayers, and patch supplies, and mistakes like uneven cut-ins or roller marks can be frustrating to fix. A professional team coordinates wall repairs, protects flooring, handles high ceilings safely, and completes the work in a fraction of the time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional saves time, ensures proper drywall prep and smooth finishes, and avoids the hassle of buying specialty tools and managing ladder safety.
